about: All three recordings read the notice the Godot Engine asks every product built with it to show. The wording below is Godot's published licence text (MIT); the line timings were measured from the recordings with a speech-recognition pass (faster-whisper, small.en) and are approximate. The recognition itself mis-heard several words, which is why the official text is shown rather than its raw output.
